question.en: Why will the police have a difficult time?
question.zh: 为什么警察的日子将不好过？

sentences.en: Why will the police have a difficult time?
sentences.zh: 为什么警察的日子将不好过？

sentences.en: The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.
sentences.zh: “绿林少年”是一个流行歌曲演唱团。

sentences.en: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 目前他们正在全国各地巡回演出。

sentences.en: They will be arriving here tomorrow.
They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
sentences.zh: 他们将乘火车来，镇上的大部分青年人将到车站迎接他们。

chunks.x: of the young people in the town

sentences.en: Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers' Club.
sentences.zh: 明晚他们将在工人俱乐部演出。

sentences.en: The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days.
sentences.zh: “绿林少年”准备在此逗留五天。

sentences.en: During this time, they will give five performances.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他们将演出五场。

sentences.en: As usual, the police will have a difficult time.
sentences.zh: 同往常一样，警察的日子将不好过。

sentences.en: They will be trying to keep order.
It is always the same on these occasions.
sentences.zh: 每逢这种场合，情况都是这样。
